svg.title: Anterior urethral spongiofibrosis
svg.desc: A normal lumen is compared with a narrowed lumen surrounded by scarred urethral and spongiosal tissue. Treatment also depends on site, length, cause, tissue quality and prior procedures. View: Conceptual anterior urethral transverse section. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: EAU Urethral Strictures: disease management in males (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urethral-strictures/chapter/disease-management-in-males; access: official full text; Indications and reconstructive principles; not a validation of every drawn tissue plane. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.
